WITH linked_fees AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
), channel_averages AS (
  SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM linked_fees
  GROUP BY orderbase
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM linked_fees
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT c.avg_feerate, c.avg_feerate - b.avg_feerate AS excess
  FROM channel_averages AS c
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE c.avg_feerate > b.avg_feerate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_channel_avg_feerate,
       AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;

assumptions.assumption: The benchmark is the average of non-NULL feerate values across all fee records linked to an order; each linked fee record is weighted equally. SQLite AVG ignores NULL values.
